description: This file defines the PGVectorStoreConfig class, which extends OpenAIVectorStoreConfig to provide configuration and utility methods specifically for connecting and interacting with a PostgreSQL vector store service. It includes methods for validating environment variables, constructing service URLs, and transforming search requests.
